title: Vendor Downtime & Cloud Infrastructure SLA Penalty Policy
rule_body: In the event of vendor cloud/service downtime exceeding 99.5% SLA commitment, a pro-rata service credit of exactly ₹5,600.00 shall be deducted via debit note from invoice INV-2026-881 prior to approving payment, rather than granting a full refund or unverified debit write-off.

title: Statutory Solvency & Minimum Debt Service Reserve Ratio
rule_body: No non-essential vendor disbursement may be approved if the projected post-settlement bank balance falls within ₹1,10,000.00 of upcoming CRITICAL_DEFAULT_RISK loan EMIs due within 15 calendar days.

title: CGST Section 16(2)(aa) & Rule 36(4) Mandatory ITC Verification
rule_body: Vendor invoices lacking matching entries in GSTR-2B or possessing zero eligible ITC must be placed on immediate payment hold to avoid cash outflow on non-creditable input taxes.

title: UPI Bank Switch Failure & Nodal Double-Debit Resolution
rule_body: Where a customer reports a double debit but the payment gateway logs indicate status failed_at_switch, funds remain in the banking switch/issuing bank node and are slated for automated RBI circular clearing. Merchants must not initiate double refunds.

title: Split Payment & Multi-UTR Duplicate Payout Prevention
rule_body: Accounts payable must inspect bank statement debits for split-disbursements against common purchase orders before executing single-tranche approval for pending ledger invoices.

title: Vendor GSTIN State Code & Name Discrepancy Tolerance
rule_body: Supplier entity names in bank narrations must be cross-matched against GSTIN records using a minimum normalized Jaro-Winkler threshold of 0.92 to prevent false-positive matching against phonetic decoys.

title: Emergency Operating Reserve Threshold
rule_body: A non-negotiable operational liquidity buffer of ₹50,000.00 must be retained in the primary clearing account at all times following all scheduled debits.

title: Dual Authorization Threshold for High-Value Payouts
rule_body: All outbound transfers exceeding ₹1,00,000.00 require secondary approval from the Head of Finance after three-way matching against PO, GRN, and GSTR-2B.

title: Payment Gateway MDR & Settlement Fee Audit
rule_body: Payment gateway settlements must be audited daily to verify that MDR fees do not exceed 2.0% plus applicable 18% GST.

title: Escalation Matrix for Recurring Vendor SLA Failures
rule_body: Vendors incurring more than two SLA penalties in a rolling 90-day window shall be placed on supplier probation with payment terms extended from Net-30 to Net-60.

title: Real-Time IFSC Validation Requirement
rule_body: Outbound NEFT/RTGS beneficiary IFSC codes must be checked against RBI master directory or Razorpay IFSC validator to ensure active branch routing.

title: GSTR-2B Filing Cutoff Date Rules
rule_body: GSTR-2B downloads on the 14th of each month represent the final binding tax baseline for supplier payments due between the 15th and end of the month.

title: Payroll Priority Ring-Fencing
rule_body: Funds allocated for monthly payroll (scheduled on the last calendar day of the month) are legally ring-fenced 5 business days in advance and cannot be diverted to trade creditors.

title: MSMED Act Section 15 Compliance for Micro & Small Enterprises
rule_body: Registered MSME vendors with valid UDYAM certificates must be paid within 45 days of invoice acceptance, provided GSTR-2B compliance is satisfied.

title: Debit Note Issuance Protocol
rule_body: Approved SLA penalty deductions must be accompanied by an officially generated debit note referencing the contract clause, vendor ticket number, and root cause analysis.
